meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: 该技能用于验证不依赖真实终端的图形界面应用：它在后台以伪终端启动应用，录制整个运行过程的每一帧，叠加你的点击与说明，最后生成并打开一个总结页，内含可跳转视频的时间线、检查项和截图快照。
howto.when: 当用户要求对某个应用做自动化验证，且希望全程录像并生成带时间线与检查结果的总结报告时触发。

say.text: 帮我验证这个应用的滚动行为，并录下全程视频。
say.note: 会按示例驱动、断言并生成总结页。

say.text: 给这个 app 做一次冒烟测试，每一步测试什么标注出来。
say.note: 输入描述会出现在字幕和摘要时间线中。

say.text: 运行验证后记得用 pixel open 打开那个总结页。
say.note: 确保总结页在分屏中打开，便于检查失败项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can drive a graphics-protocol app headlessly in a pty, capture every emitted frame, overlay clicks and captions, encode a video, and open a summary page with a seekable timeline, pass/fail checks, and stills.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automatically verify an app and want a recorded run plus a summary page with timeline and checks.

say_en.text: Verify this app's scrolling behavior and record the whole run.
say_en.note: Drives, asserts, and produces a summary page.

say_en.text: Smoke-test this app and label what each step is testing.
say_en.note: Descriptions appear in captions and the timeline.

say_en.text: After the run, open the summary page with pixel open.
say_en.note: Shows it in a split so failures are visible.
